title: InsightChat
description: A simple, lightweight plugin that sends helpful messages into the chat that you can configure!
body: The Tips Plugin enhances your Minecraft server by sending helpful tips to players at regular intervals. Customize the tips via the configuration file to provide advice, server commands, or important reminders. Perfect for engaging players and ensuring they’re informed about features like land protection, earning money, setting homes, and more. This lightweight and easy-to-use plugin ensures a smooth, personalized experience for all players on your server.
